title: Warn players earlier (e.g. at the Vale, when recruiting a fourth companion) that carrying a full party has a real chance of leaving one or more companion arcs permanently unresolved once the road to Marrowgate opens, so the choice to recruit widely vs. deeply is made with eyes open.
